name: The Ur-Sphinx
oracle_text:
Eminence — As long as The Ur-Sphinx is in the command zone or on the battlefield, other Sphinx spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.
Flying
Whenever one or more Sphinxes you control attack, each player mills that many cards. For each player, you may cast a card that player milled this way without paying its mana cost.
blocked_sentences: Whenever one or more Sphinxes you control attack, each player mills that many cards. For each player, you may cast a card that player milled this way without paying its mana cost.

needs.what: an op that, for each player, lets you cast one card from among the cards that player milled this way (a mill `as` binding, cards in another player's graveyard) without paying its mana cost
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cast_from_hand casts free but builds its pool only from the caster's own zone lists, so it can never reach a card in an opponent's graveyard, and it offers one card total rather than one per player; play_exiled and look_at_top's cast_free read exile and the library top, not graveyards; grant_graveyard_cast and grant_playable charge the printed cost. The 'that many' count of attacking Sphinxes from a batched attack trigger is also unconfirmed
